meta.parties: In Re De Mel Et Al

rules.statement: A sole surviving trustee is entitled to appoint new trustees for the purpose of filling vacancies caused by death or incapacity, under Section 75 of the Trusts Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where in a trust deed there was no power vested in the trustees specifically named or their successors, who are designated therein, to appoint any new trustees, a sole surviving trustee is entitled by virtue of the provisions of section 75 of the Trusts Ordinance to appoint new trustees for the purpose of filling vacancies caused by death or incapacity."
